help.plan: Set your goal and see how far you've come. Click "Edit plan" to adjust the income you want in the future, your contributions and the assumptions.
help.projection: How your net worth should evolve over your whole life: it grows with contributions until retirement, then funds your income. The shaded band spans the pessimistic-to-optimistic range. Hover for values and milestones.
help.milestones: Wins on the path to freedom — each is your passive income covering a slice of the income you want. See at what age you reach each one and how much is left.
help.progress: Track your real net worth month by month and compare it to what the plan projected. Record the current month or backfill past ones.

empty.title: When do you want to stop working out of necessity?

cards.never: Out of reach at current pace
cards.fireNumberSub: the wealth that funds your income forever

gap.title: Target income vs. your current spending
gap.above: Your target income ({target}/mo) is {percent} above what you spend today ({current}/mo).
gap.below: Your target income ({target}/mo) is {percent} below what you spend today ({current}/mo).
gap.equal: Your target income ({target}/mo) matches your current spending ({current}/mo).
gap.aboveHint: You'll live better than today — which means accumulating more. Increase contributions or extend the horizon.
gap.belowHint: You plan to live on less than you spend today. Trimming spending now meaningfully speeds up arrival.
gap.equalHint: You keep exactly your current standard of living.
gap.noBaseline: Not enough recorded spending yet to compare.

planning.title: How to plan
planning.byDate: By date → how much to invest
planning.byDateHint: Tell us when you want to retire; we compute the required contribution.
planning.byContributionHint: Tell us how much you can contribute; we project the date.

required.title: Required contribution per phase
required.unreachable: Even with contributions, this date isn't reachable under the current assumptions. Extend the horizon, lower the target income, or revise the return.

projection.title: Wealth projection
projection.successHint: % of Monte Carlo simulations that sustain your income to life expectancy.
projection.successHintDepletion: Since you plan to spend down to zero by life expectancy, ~50% is expected: in the median the money lasts exactly that long. Above it you leave a surplus; below, you fall a little short.
projection.needsAge: Set your current age in the plan to see the whole-life projection and chance of success.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.coastReached: Reached — your investments alone reach the goal by the date, even with no new contributions.
milestones.coastNotReached: {amount} to go before you could stop contributing and let it compound.
milestones.addCustomHint: Create a custom goal with a criterion.
milestones.type_net_worth_x_expenses: Net worth in multiples of expenses
milestones.valueHint_passive_income_absolute: Monthly income the portfolio should sustain.
milestones.valueHint_net_worth_x_expenses: Multiple of annual expenses (e.g. 25 = the 4% rule).

history.title: Progress over time
history.subtitle: Save a snapshot of your net worth each month (Record) to see your real evolution and compare it to the projection.
history.empty: Tracking starts now. Come back month over month to see your evolution.
history.snapshotDialogHint: Enter the invested net worth for that month (handy for backfilling past months).

form.title: Your financial freedom plan
form.description: Everything is editable. Defaults come tuned for Brazil.
form.name: Plan name
form.currentAgeHint: Needed to project the whole life (accumulate → withdraw) and the chance of success.
form.strategyPerpetuityHint: You live on returns alone and never touch the principal — it lasts forever and can be inherited. Needs the largest number.
form.strategyDepletionHint: You draw the capital down over time, to near zero at life expectancy. Needs less capital than living off the yield, but carries more risk — the chance of success is usually a bit lower.
form.strategyHint: This sets how big your FIRE number is. "Live off the yield" is safer; "spend it down" gets you there faster. Tune life expectancy in Advanced assumptions.
form.includeBusinessInvestmentsHint: Also count investments held in business accounts, not only personal ones.
form.targetMonthlyIncomeHint: How much you want to receive monthly once free (in today's money).
form.safeWithdrawalRateHint: How much of the portfolio you withdraw per year. In Brazil, 3.5% is more conservative than the classic 4%.
form.profileHintByDate: Choose how to spread contributions over time; we compute the amount needed.
form.profileHintByContribution: Choose the shape and the amount you can contribute.
form.requiredContributionLabel: Contribution needed for the target date
form.requiredUnreachable: Even contributing, this date isn't reachable with the current assumptions. Extend the deadline, lower the target income or revise the return.
